description: A 2-axis analog joystick with an integrated push button.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, VERT/HORZ are analog outputs (each axis reads ~VCC/2 at rest/center), SEL is the button — normally open, shorts to GND when the stick is pressed straight down.

plain.what: A thumb joystick like on a game controller — it tells the Arduino which way you push it.
plain.how: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, HORZ and VERT to two analog pins. Centred, both read about 512; push the stick and the numbers change.

pins.VERT: up–down: an analog voltage, mid-way when centred
pins.HORZ: left–right: an analog voltage, mid-way when centred
pins.SEL: the push-down button: joins GND when pressed
